Priya R: handing off evening shift now (ts 6155556666). Quick TL;DR from last 6h: embedding autoscaler oscillation in us-west caused a burst of cold-start pages ~18:10-18:30 UTC. We stabilized by pinning a small pool and enabling warmstart; current status: steady. Customer-facing inference endpoints unaffected; internal background embedding jobs saw 5-10% transient errors for ~20m (mostly low-priority batch jobs).

Priya R: who is primary/secondary for the next 6h? Primary: Sam K, Secondary: Alex G. If anything degrades, page Sam first, escalate to Alex after 5m.

Sam K: ack. I have pager notification on. Can you drop the quick checklist for the warmstart rollback/playbook?

Priya R: sure — checklist below (also pinned in runbook):
- ✅ Pin embedding-pool-usw-1 to 6 nodes (done)
- ✅ Set warmstart=true in pool config (done)
- ✅ Temporarily bump minReplicas to 3 for the next 30m (done)
- 🔁 Monitor autoscaler metric: embeddings_autoscaler::scale_rate / prom query below

Priya R: PromQL to watch: `sum(rate(embedding_request_duration_seconds_count{region="us-west"}[5m])) by (instance)` and `increase(k8s_container_restart_count{container="embedding-worker",namespace="redwood-embed"}[15m])`

Priya R: quick commands if you need to re-check pool state:
```bash
# k8s context
kubectl --context=us-west get hpa -n redwood-embed
kubectl --context=us-west describe deployment embedding-worker -n redwood-embed
# check pool autoscaler config
rdctl pool get embedding-pool-usw-1 --field warmstart,minReplicas
```

ops-bot: Incident detected: embedding-autoscaler-oscillation (auto-page) at 6155556770. Page auto-closed at 6155556830 after manual intervention. Pager summary: ~40 pages suppressed via aggregation.

Sam K: thanks, ops-bot. Confirmed pool pinned and warmstart applied. I'm keeping an eye on p95/p99 tokenization latency too.

Maria L: one follow-up: we need to adjust the stabilization window in the autoscaler to avoid thrash. Current window is 30s; suggest 120s and add a cooldown of 60s. I'll own the config change if you approve.

Alex G: if we see re-oscillation, prepared to roll back the recent autoscaler tuning change from this morning (commit abc123) and route traffic to dedicated-embed-1 as soft fallback. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m.

Sam K: noted. For rollback do we have the canary runbook handy? Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollback (please check permissions)

Priya R: adding short playbook snippet to thread for quick copy-paste:
```text
# emergency fallback
1) rdctl routes modify embed-route --target dedicated-embed-1 --weight 10
2) watch logs: rdctl logs --service embed-ingest --since 5m
3) if stable after 5m, bump weight to 50, then 100
4) notify customers via status if >30m
```

oncall-helper: Reminder — if the same pager fires 3x within 1h, escalate to SRE lead (Maria L) and open incident channel `#inc-embed-osc`

Sam K: one note — some customers run long batch jobs overnight; we should avoid mass restarting embedding workers while those jobs are running. Can we surface a grace window?

Priya R: good call. Grace window = 01:00-06:00 local for major customers; for us-west fallback, prefer pin + warmstart instead of restart unless critical. I'll add that to the runbook.

Maria L: I'll submit the autoscaler PR with stabilization=120s + cooldown=60s and link it here when ready. Expected to merge in ~30m after review. Owner: Maria L.

Alex G: I'll prepare the rollback patch and test against staging right now. Will post test results in 15m.

ops-bot: Note — suppressed 37 similar alerts by aggregation rule `embed_autoscaler_burst_agg`.

Sam K: current metrics I'm watching:
- embed_queue_length (prom) — stable around 3
- embedding_error_rate — dropping toward normal (0.7% now)
- node_restart_count — 0 in last 10m

Priya R: current customer impact: internal batch jobs delayed; external latency unaffected. Severity: S2 for internal processing. No status page incident required right now but we'll escalate if errors persist >30m or affect external endpoints.

Priya R: outstanding action items:
- Maria L: PR to widen stabilization window (30m) [in progress]
- Alex G: rollback + staging test (15m) [in progress]
- Sam K: monitor p95/p99 and keep oncall channel updated (ongoing)
- Priya R: update runbook and add grace window note (30m)

Sam K: ack. I'll do 15m checks and ping at +15/+45 mins.

Alex G: test pass on staging, small FRR (fast restart) flakiness observed — logging more details to the PR.

Priya R: handing off now. If anything fires, page Sam first. I'm available on slack until 20:30 UTC if you need context. Leaving the thread pinned in eng-oncall. :seatbelt: :white_check_mark:

oncall-helper: Hand-off recorded: primary=Sam K secondary=Alex G handoff_ts=6155556666 duration=6h notes="embedding autoscaler thrash mitigated; follow-ups assigned"

Sam K: thanks Priya — taking over.
